headline: Piastri takes a 10-place grid penalty in Las Vegas
body: Piastri will fit a fifth Mercedes engine of the season after a reliability issue, which costs him 10 places on the grid. McLaren expects him to recover positions with overtaking in the race.

headline: Las Vegas forecast: cold and dry all weekend
body: Air temperatures run from 4C to 14C across the weekend, with no rain forecast for practice, qualifying or the race. Last year's qualifying was wet.

headline: Alonso will race the Dakar Rally for Aston Martin in January
body: Alonso returns to Dakar seven years after finishing 13th with Toyota, driving an Aston Martin Dreadnought run by Prodrive with Marc Coma as co-driver. Dakar runs 9 to 23 January, and he stays at Aston Martin in Formula 1 for 2027.

headline: FIA posts, then deletes, a 2030 V8 engine announcement
body: FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem posted "V8s coming soon" after Monday's meeting with manufacturers and Formula 1, and related posts were then removed. The understanding is of broad agreement on a turbocharged 2.1-litre V8 with a smaller electrical element, with a 2030 framework due at the World Motor Sport Council on 10 December.
